digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and git fetch optimization
propositions: Add filter: blob:none to all actions/checkout@v7 steps in reconcile-bridge.yml, verify-identity.yml, and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml while retaining fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref settings
Add explicit --filter=blob:none to both require-ticket (depth-1) and verify-identity (full-history) fetches in gerrit-verify.yaml, preserving their respective depth semantics
Implement production guards that parse git count-objects -v output and fail fetch operations exceeding declared pack size limits (102400 KiB for standalone, 131072 KiB for Gerrit)
Verify via real git daemon fixture with packet tracing that named-origin inheritance and direct URL fetches negotiate filter capability and actually omit the known large historical blob
Ensure standalone and Gerrit verify-identity jobs maintain exact git count-objects -v state before and after materialization, detecting unintended promisor object accumulation
